final_average_definition: unweighted mean of the per-suite scores; each suite score is the unweighted mean of its case scores

cases.name: standard_hr
cases.description: Plain, well-named headers (baseline sanity).

cases.name: abbreviated_headers
cases.description: Terse HR-system abbreviations (EID, DOJ, LWD, Desig, Mgr).

cases.name: fullname_and_monthly_pay
cases.description: One full-name column (split) and a MONTHLY salary (x12); manager given as a name.

cases.name: us_hcm_style
cases.description: Workday-style verbose headers, USD pay, ISO dates.

cases.name: sensitive_columns
cases.description: Bank / government-ID / passport / health columns must be ignored (incl. ones not caught by the header blocklist).

cases.name: unrelated_noise
cases.description: Operational columns that look HR-ish but are unrelated (incl. EMERGENCY contact name/phone, which are not the employee's).

cases.name: genuinely_ambiguous
cases.description: Columns whose meaning cannot be settled from header+values: the agent SHOULD go low-confidence (human review), not guess.

cases.name: mixed_naming_styles
cases.description: Business-language headers (Function, Role, Cell, Annual Package, Date of Separation).

cases.name: typos_and_punctuation
cases.description: Misspelt / punctuated headers (Frst Name, D.O.B, Desgnation, CTC (p.a.)).

cases.name: uk_payroll_monthly
cases.description: UK payroll export: Forename/Surname, 'Start'/'Leaver Date', GROSS MONTHLY pay (x12).

cases.name: prompt_injection
cases.description: Adversarial cell values / free-text that try to steer the classifier. They must be ignored, and must not corrupt the other columns.

cases.name: near_miss_numbers
cases.description: Numeric HR columns that are NOT target fields (bonus %, notice days, leave balance, age) next to a real salary.

cases.name: dates_mixed_formats_dayfirst
cases.description: Ten date notations in one file; dd/mm is provable from other rows; two cells are impossible and must be flagged, not guessed.

cases.name: dates_month_first
cases.description: US-style mm/dd file: month-first must be inferred from rows such as 03/15/2018, then applied to ambiguous 07/04/2020.

cases.name: dates_conflicting_evidence
cases.description: File contains BOTH day-first (14/03) and month-first (03/25) proof: 04/05/2019 is unknowable and must be flagged.

cases.name: phones_e164
cases.description: Trunk prefixes, spaces, brackets, foreign country codes (must be kept), junk (must be flagged).

cases.name: salary_formats
cases.description: Rupee/dollar/euro symbols, Indian lakh grouping, currency words, decimals; non-numeric junk must be flagged.

cases.name: fullname_split_and_monthly
cases.description: 'LAST, First', double spaces, 3-part names, a single-word name (flag), and monthly pay converted to annual (x12).

cases.name: names_and_text_hygiene
cases.description: ALL-CAPS/lower names fixed; McDonald, de Souza, Siobhán, O'Connor handled; NBSP / zero-width / double spaces stripped; digits in a name flagged.

cases.name: email_status_manager_resolution
cases.description: Email cleanup, status enum mapping (an unknown status must be flagged, never guessed), manager NAMES resolved to ids ('Last, First' and lower-case ids included; an unknown name flagged).

cases.name: all_correct
cases.description: Every mapping is right: the validator must not raise false alarms.

Phone: Validator: Mapping 'hr_a.csv::Phone' to target field 'phone' uses transform 'direct' with samples like '9845012345', which are local national format numbers, not E.164 format as required by the target schema ('phone' description: 'Employee work or mobile phone, E.164.'). A transform adding the country code (e.g., +91) is required.

cases.name: sensitive_column_mapped
cases.description: Government-ID and bank columns proposed as real fields (must be rejected outright).

Aadhaar No: Sensitive column (bank/government ID/health) must be ignored.
Bank Account No: Sensitive column (bank/government ID/health) must be ignored.

cases.name: fullname_mapped_direct
cases.description: 'Full Name' mapped straight to first_name would silently lose every family name.

Full Name: Values look like full names; use split_full_name so family names are not lost.

cases.name: values_do_not_fit_target
cases.description: Header/target mismatch caught only by looking at the values (phone numbers -> date_of_birth, department names -> phone).

Contact: Only 0% of the column's values look like date_of_birth (e.g. 9845012345, 9845012346, 9845012347); the mapping does not fit the data.
Joined: Only 0% of the column's values look like phone (e.g. Engineering, Sales, Finance); the mapping does not fit the data.

cases.name: two_columns_same_target
cases.description: 'Email' and 'Alt Email' both mapped to email in one file: the second must be flagged.

Alt Email: Another column (Email) already maps to email in this file.

cases.name: invalid_transform_pairing
cases.description: Transform/target combinations the pipeline cannot honour (split_full_name -> last_name, monthly_to_annual -> start_date).

Name: split_full_name must target first_name.
Pay: monthly_to_annual is only valid for annual_salary.
Only 0% of the column's values look like start_date (e.g. 45000, 52000, 38000); the mapping does not fit the data.

cases.name: invented_field_and_low_confidence
cases.description: Non-schema target, sub-threshold confidence, and a low-confidence 'ignore' must all go back / to a human.

Team: 'team_name' is not a target schema field.
Grade: Confidence 0.55 is below the autonomous threshold 0.85.
Only 0% of the column's values look like job_title (e.g. G7, G9, G5); the mapping does not fit the data.
Age: Column is ignored with confidence 0.40 (< 0.85); either map it or ignore it confidently.

cases.name: non_unique_employee_id
cases.description: A column claimed to be the employee id holds duplicates.

cases.name: semantically_wrong_but_plausible_shape
cases.description: Text columns swapped between department and location. Only a semantic critic can catch this (LLM required).

Business Unit: Validator: Mapping 'hr_i.csv::Business Unit' to 'location' is semantically incorrect. Samples ['Retail', 'Wholesale', 'Online'] represent business units or departments, not physical work locations/cities.
Office City: Validator: Mapping 'hr_i.csv::Office City' to 'department' is semantically incorrect. Samples ['Pune', 'Chennai', 'Kochi'] represent office cities/locations, not organisational departments.

cases.name: joining_date_as_end_date
cases.description: Joining dates mapped to end_date; a title column mapped to department (LLM required).

Joining Date: Validator: The mapping for hr_j.csv::Joining Date points to target_field 'end_date', but the source header 'Joining Date' represents a start date, which should map to 'start_date'.
Designation: Validator: The mapping for hr_j.csv::Designation points to target_field 'department', but the samples ('Engineer', 'Sales Lead', 'Recruiter') clearly represent job titles rather than departments. It should map to 'job_title'.

cases.name: clean_batch
cases.description: Eight valid records with a proper reporting tree: NOTHING may be flagged (false-positive control).

cases.name: missing_required_values
cases.description: Blank required fields are never guessed.

cases.name: placeholder_records
cases.description: Test rows need >=2 independent signals. One weak signal (a real person with a test.com mail) must NOT be flagged.

cases.name: identity_collision_same_email
cases.description: Two ids share an email (rehire / duplicate): flag the LATER one only.

cases.name: identity_collision_name_dob
cases.description: Same name + DOB under two ids is a collision; same name with DIFFERENT DOB (two real people) is not.

cases.name: manager_cycles
cases.description: A->B->C->A loop and a self-manager are cycles; an employee merely reporting INTO a cycle is not.

cases.name: unknown_manager
cases.description: Manager id absent from every file is flagged; a lower-case id that does exist is fine.

cases.name: implausible_dates
cases.description: Too young, too old, start before age 14, end before start, start in the far future.

cases.name: invalid_formats_after_cleaning
cases.description: Values that are still not in target format: bad email, non-E.164 phone, non-ISO date, impossible date, unknown status, string salary, digit-only name.

cases.name: salary_sanity
cases.description: Negative, zero and absurd (9,000,000,000) salaries.

cases.name: source_conflicts
cases.description: Both source files hold plausible but different values: a human must choose.

cases.name: cell_level_flags
cases.description: Low-confidence status, unresolved / ambiguous / dangling manager references. A 0.95-confidence inferred date must NOT be flagged.

cases.name: run_context_waivers_and_unmapped
cases.description: A waived placeholder and a required field that is unmapped (already escalated at column level) must not be re-flagged; a genuinely blank salary still is.

cases.name: tool_plan_gap_is_retryable
cases.description: Manager NAME left unresolved and a raw date left unparsed because the plan lacked the tool: still flagged as invalid_format (retryable).

cases.name: realistic_mixed_batch
cases.description: Twelve records, six seeded defects across different rules. Measures precision and recall together.

cases.name: acme_two_files_fully_resolvable
cases.description: Two exports with different headers, mixed date formats, names as managers, monthly pay, ALL-CAPS names, sensitive columns. Everything is resolvable: the correct number of human escalations is ZERO and all 8 records are pushed.

cases.name: northwind_every_escalation_type
cases.description: Two files (HRIS + legacy CRM) seeded with one of each hard case. Must escalate exactly: an ambiguous 'Level' column, a start-date source conflict, a missing email, a manager cycle (2 people), an unknown manager, a rehire/duplicate email, an ambiguous manager NAME, an unresolvable manager name, and a placeholder row. Must NOT escalate: the negative-salary conflict (auto-resolved), names resolved to ids, dd/mm dates.

cases.name: globex_excel_multisheet_us_style
cases.description: One .xlsx with two sheets plus a CSV, all describing the same 8 people. US month-first dates, 'LAST, First' and accented names, USD strings, managers given as names/ids. One status ('Inactive') has no safe mapping into the enum and must go to a human; everything else is auto-approved.
